description: Defines the KernelTimeout class for managing timeouts with nanosecond granularity, including absolute and relative timeouts, conversions to various time representations, and system clock support. Used internally within the Abseil synchronization library.

classes.name: KernelTimeout
classes.description: Represents an optional timeout with nanosecond precision, supporting absolute and relative timeouts, conversions, and system clock support.

methods.name: KernelTimeout(absl::Time t)
methods.description: Constructs an absolute timeout that expires at the specified time.

methods.name: KernelTimeout(absl::Duration d)
methods.description: Constructs a relative timeout that expires after the specified duration.

methods.name: static constexpr KernelTimeout Never()
methods.description: Factory method returning an infinite timeout.

methods.name: has_timeout()
methods.description: Checks if the timeout will eventually expire.

methods.name: is_absolute_timeout()
methods.description: Checks if the timeout was provided as an absolute time.

methods.name: is_relative_timeout()
methods.description: Checks if the timeout was provided as a relative duration.

methods.name: MakeAbsTimespec()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a timespec for absolute timeout interfaces.

methods.name: MakeRelativeTimespec()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a timespec for relative timeout interfaces.

methods.name: MakeClockAbsoluteTimespec(clockid_t c)
methods.description: Converts to a timespec for a specific clock, used on non-Windows systems.

methods.name: MakeAbsNanos()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to nanoseconds since the epoch.

methods.name: InMillisecondsFromNow()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to milliseconds from now, or INFINITE if no timeout.

methods.name: ToChronoTimePoint()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a std::chrono::time_point for absolute timeouts.

methods.name: ToChronoDuration()
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a std::chrono::nanoseconds duration for relative timeouts.
